rules.statement: In a partition decree assigning lots to a family group without defining the interests of the members inter se, subsequent actions may be instituted for further partitioning.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where a partition decree assigns certain lots to a number of persons as a group who derive their title from the same source, without defining the interests of the members of that group inter se, a subsequent partition action may be instituted for the purpose of partitioning the land comprising the lots which were assigned to that group."
